notes: All 6 required web searches ran this time, plus one on Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors (7 total). None found any statement by Newhouse on superintelligence, extinction or existential risk, a pause or slowdown, an agreement with China, or AI safety; the superintelligence and AI-safety searches returned only Dan Hendrycks, a different person. The Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act search found the House bill (H.R. 10538, Casar, 24 September 2026); no source listed Newhouse as a cosponsor, but the full cosponsor list on Congress.gov was not opened. No House letter on AI risk signed or led by him was found. The op-ed quote was re-checked at source this session: the sentence continues with a comma ('alone, it will be won by the country...'), so the quote stops at 'alone' and is one continuous passage. The page lists 17 July 2026 as the posting date; the op-ed first appeared in The Center Square on 16 July 2026. From the earlier attempt: an 11 May 2026 press release on his Central Washington Energy Summit paraphrases him saying 'how the nation must meet this moment regarding artificial intelligence'; that is the office's paraphrase, so it is left out of statements. His site also mentions support for AI funding in the defense authorization and energy-and-water appropriations bills and a co-signed letter on the Rural Health Transformation Fund that mentions AI in passing; none has catastrophic-risk content, and these were not opened. One search summary described an unnamed Republican official saying he had no concerns about AI and human extinction; the snippet does not name him, so nothing is attributed to Newhouse.
